page.title: Returns & Exchanges
page.metaDescription: How to return or exchange items purchased from Diba Gallery.

contentHero.title: Returns & exchanges
contentHero.subtitle: We want you to love every piece. If something is not right, here is how we can help.

contentBlocks.heading: Eligibility
contentBlocks.lead: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery if:
paragraphs: They are unused and in original packaging where applicable
Custom-made or clearance items marked final sale are excluded

contentBlocks.heading: How to start a return
paragraphs: Contact our customer service team with your order number.
We will arrange collection or provide return instructions for your region.
Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5–10 business days after inspection.
